data.title: bn-vyp: Build RIBBIT RECOIL vertical-slice game

data.body: [P2] The documented multi-level seam is not actually data-driven here: boss activation and level completion are fixed to level-one coordinates, while draw_exit() also fixes the evac at (932,448). A second LEVELS entry with different geometry cannot start or finish through build_level(index) alone. Add per-level boss_trigger and exit position/hitbox fields and consume them here and in draw_exit(), so later levels do not require edits to shared gameplay logic.

[P2] This scenario proves real controller traversal only through the first hook, then uses dev_warp for every remaining route/pickup, dev_start_boss/dev_damage_boss for the encounter, and another warp for evac; the Rust regressions follow the same pattern. Therefore all gates can pass even if the authored level becomes impossible after the opening grapple. Add a deterministic no-warp controller replay that reaches both checkpoints, collects the mutations naturally, enters the boss arena, and boards evac; keep the existing developer-hook stages as focused combat/state tests.

data.reason: Changes requested: make boss/exit progression level-data driven and add no-warp end-to-end traversal coverage for the authored level. Core mechanics and integrity checks otherwise pass.

data.body: Fixed: LEVELS now owns boss spawn/ranges/HP, boss trigger, forcefield gate, and evac draw/hitbox geometry. Shared update/draw logic consumes only those fields; the gate remains a data-driven player barrier that does not block mutation fire.

Fixed: added ribbit-recoil-traversal.playtest.json, a 132-stage/1810-frame replay with zero eval stages. Controller input alone reaches both checkpoints, collects both mutations, detonates the refinery gate, enters and defeats the boss, opens evac, and wins. The Rust regression executes it twice and compares the complete reports.

data.reason: Addressed in workspace; focused traversal, asset/audio, full just check, and packed Chromium browser gates pass
Addressed in workspace; focused traversal, asset/audio, full just check, and packed Chromium browser gates pass

Re-review LGTM: level data now owns boss spawn/ranges/HP, trigger, arena gate, and evac geometry through shared update/draw paths. The new 132-stage controller-only scenario has zero eval stages, passes at 1810 frames twice with identical reports, and is exercised twice by the focused Rust regression. Six focused tests, both scenarios, and strict sprite/map/music checks pass.
